name: notebooklm-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration for Google NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook) RAG retrieval

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.description: Lists all available NotebookLM notebooks for the user, returning notebook IDs, titles, and creation timestamps.

tools.name: retrieve_relevant_chunks
tools.description: Retrieves semantic, keyword-grounded text chunks from a target notebook.

name.description: Resource name of the notebook, e.g. 'notebooks/{notebook_id}'

query.description: Dense, decomposed semantic search query string (strip conversational filler)

source_names.description: Optional list of specific source document titles to filter within the notebook

claudeDesktop.instructions: Add the following block to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows)
